about.title: This section is now Blog
about.intro: Hello, I'm Martín. I spent almost 10 years in the business world until I discovered that code was my thing too. Today I focus on software development, mixing my business experience with the creativity of programming and implementing AI. I enjoy working with web technologies like JavaScript, React, Node.js, but above all I'm passionate about learning, building and sharing projects that really add value to people.
about.p1: My approach joins technical precision with a human commercial lens. I turn ideas into digital platforms by iterating and learning every day. Beyond the code, I own the project lifecycle so technology actually drives business goals and real impact.
about.p2: I spent almost ten years in business — including as business-unit manager at PalFarma — until code became mine too. As an independent developer and later at Menta, I built technology for health professionals and clinics, bridging user needs and the engineering team. Today, as Forward Deployed Engineer at Citus.dev, I keep product, engineering, and customers on the same board.
about.p3: I also build community: I'm a GDG Quito organizer, a speaker at Cursor workshops and e-commerce and AI talks, and I care about sharing what works when you iterate in public. People first: products people actually love.
